text: P01 plan: (1) h01 task: src/solve/problem.ts parses and validates a problem file per GOAL.md (every field, one line per bad field naming it, paths relative to the file's folder, folder must be in a git repo), plus src/cli/problem.ts for 'problem check' (exit 0 + summary, exit 1 + lines). Unit tests in test/solve-problem.test.ts. (2) h02: glob.ts, then P15 synthe.self.json which must pass 'problem check'. No milestone test file for P01 is on integration yet; I build to the GOAL.md contract.
P01 verdict: easy. Pure validation, no loop. One PR after the skeleton lands.

h01-1 ready on swarm/h01/h01-1, 26 tests. API in src/solve/problem.ts: loadProblem(file) -> {ok:true, problem} | {ok:false, errors:string[]}; validateProblem(raw, dir); problemSummary(p). Problem = {version,name,goal,artifact,protect,measure:{kind:'command',command,direction,unit,runs}|{kind:'judge',cases,run,compare,runs},guards,holdout,proposer:{kind:'command',command}|{kind:'model'},budget:{maxRounds,maxCalls|null},model:{baseUrl,model}|null,dir,repo}. CLI: problemCommand(args) in src/cli/problem.ts returns the exit code; errors go to stdout, one per line. lead: wire 'problem' to problemCommand(process.argv.slice(3)), or I adapt to your stub. Waiting for the skeleton.
h01-1 PR open: https://github.com/synthelabs/synthe/pull/109 (problem.ts on types.ts names; optional top-level 'candidates', default 1). Merge job pending.

P04+P05 plan (h01): one end-to-end test file per milestone, test/solve-languages.test.ts (P04: Python project + plain shell project, no package.json, measure and guards in those languages) and test/solve-artifacts.test.ts (P05: JSON config tuning, Markdown doc scored by a script, CSV cleaned to raise a quality score). Each builds a temp git repo, a scripted outside proposer, runs 'node src/cli/main.ts solve', and checks result.json, the branch, and the clean working tree. Fix what breaks in the modules with a note to the owner. These need loop.ts (h05) to land; until then I write the fixtures and run them against open branches.

P04 verdict: easy once P02 lands; the risk is commands that assume node or package.json (PATH, shell, dep links in scratch). P05 verdict: easy; risk is CSV/Markdown edits with CRLF or exact-once search text.
P01 PASS on integration (32/32, npm run milestones -- P01). Now on P04/P05: my e2e tests are on swarm/h01/h01-2; next I read the frozen P04/P05 checks and wait for loop.ts.

h07, h05: P05 frozen checks use measure.runs 1 with exact (noise-free) scores, and P04 uses runs 2. decide() must keep a strict gain when runs is 1 or when every run gives the same number (zero spread); the P06 statistics apply only when there is spread. Also P04 Python: the checks set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, but a person's run will make __pycache__ in scratch; commit only artifact paths, never 'git add -A'.
